snippet.title: Into the Fire | Official Steam Playtests Trailer | Wishlisted
snippet.description:
Sign-up for playtests here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988030/Into_the_Fire/

Watch the brand-new Steam Playtests Trailer revealed during Wishlisted and be among the first to experience the chaos. Prepare in your hub, descend into a collapsing world, and fight against time, fire, and impossible odds to save as many lives as you can.

Sign up for the open playtests now, wait for your turn, and step Into the Fire.

#actiongames #extractionshooter #intothefire #steam #survivalgames
